headerDisplay: Exposes Vera (MiOS/Ezlo) Z-Wave devices and scenes to HomeKit. Enter the IP address or hostname of your Vera controller below.
footerDisplay: For help and bug reports, see the [project repository](https://github.com/damianxd/homebridge-vera).

name.title: Name
name.description: Plugin name as displayed in the Homebridge log.

veraIP.title: Vera IP Address / Hostname
veraIP.description: The IP address or hostname of your Vera controller.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often (in milliseconds) to poll the Vera controller for live device state.

includesensor.title: Include Sensors
includesensor.description: Expose motion, contact, light, humidity, smoke, CO and temperature sensors.

houseModes.title: Expose House Modes as a Security System

saveBrightness.title: Restore Brightness on Power On (colour lights)

ignoreplugins.title: Ignore Plugins
ignoreplugins.description: Skip devices whose device type or altid contains any of these strings (e.g. Nest, PhilipsHue, Wemo).

garageLocks.title: Garage Locks
garageLocks.description: Lock device IDs that should be presented as garage doors in HomeKit.
